proposition: GET /metrics: contract says the successful metrics response has media type text/plain; implementation does send the scrape body without setting its Content-Type.
GET /v1/events: contract says from_date and to_date are optional; implementation does unconditionally parse both nullable query parameters with ZonedDateTime.parse
POST /groups/{groupId}/artifacts: contract says dryRun=true produces no persistent changes; implementation does pass false to version creation when an existing artifact takes FIND_OR_CREATE_VERSION

POST /groups/{groupId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/contract/status: contract says status is a required non-null lifecycle string and invalid requests receive 400; implementation does dereference a null status before parameter validation and map the resulting exception to 500
POST /v1/payments: contract says the create-payment response property is named paymentId; implementation does serialize the property as payment_id
GET /forecast-spec: contract says designator-mask filters forecast specification designators; implementation does read designator instead of designator-mask for the filter

POST /v1/trees/branch/{branchName}/transplant: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration

POST /v1/trees/branch/{branchName}/merge: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration
POST /shells/{aasIdentifier}/submodel-refs: contract says creating an already existing resource receives 409; implementation does append a duplicate submodel reference and return 201
GET /lookup/shells: contract says assetIds is optional; implementation does call stream on the nullable assetIds argument
GET /v1/refunds: contract says the navigation property is named _links; implementation does expose navigation through the unannotated getLinks getter as links

POST /groups/{groupId}/artifacts: contract says X-Registry-Name and X-Registry-Description specify the submitted artifact metadata; implementation does omit those header values when an existing artifact takes the UPDATE or RETURN_OR_UPDATE branch
POST /{scopeId}/devices/{deviceId}/requests: contract says the JSON response model is DeviceCommandOutput; implementation does return a JsonGenericResponseMessage wrapping the generic device response
GET /v1/directdebit/payments: contract says state must match the published lowercase pattern; implementation does validate that pattern with CASE_INSENSITIVE enabled
GET /api/keycloak/config: contract says public-client has string type; implementation does serialize public-client as the boolean true

GET /hosts/products/{product_id}: contract says beginning and ending are optional for the OpenShift metrics products; implementation does wrap absent dates with Optional.of in the special-product branch.

PUT /v1/trees/{referenceType}/{referenceName}: contract says the OpenAPI expectedHash query parameter is not marked required; implementation does require a non-null expectedHash through the inherited validation declaration
PUT /configurations/{configId}: contract says the numeric configuration-update field is named description; implementation does read and update the numeric field named value

GET /api/v1/management/protocol-adapters/adapters/{adapterId}/tags: contract says 200 contains an application/json DomainTagModelList; implementation does return a bodyless 200 when the configured adapter has an empty tag list.
POST /version/v1/registrationToken: contract says successful token generation returns 200; implementation does return 201 for successful GUID token generation
